_source: The map room's levels (see Maps.cs). A map's border is [minX, minY, maxX, maxY]; walls are [ax, ay, bx, by]; redirectors [ax, ay, bx, by, heading]. A random map is laid afresh each round and has no geometry.

maps.name: Practice Range
maps.description: Mirror walls across the upper corners, a wall in the middle and two redirectors: every kind of bounce in one room.

maps.name: Crossfire
maps.description: Two walls lean in over the middle, the lower corners are cut off, and a redirector under the centre sends shots straight up.

maps.name: Pillars
maps.description: Short standing walls all over the room: plenty to bank off, little to hide behind.

maps.name: Funnel
maps.description: Long walls slope down from the upper corners towards the middle; a redirector on the right wall throws shots back up and in.

maps.name: Random Arena
maps.description: A new level every round, as in the original: twenty abstract polygons turned any way, none overlapping, and everyone starts at a random spot. R in practice rolls another.
